paragraphs: A day planner that knows how much actually fits. Type design review 90m next tuesday and it becomes a task on the right day with the right estimate — then the app tells you whether that day is still possible.
Most task apps happily let you promise yourself fourteen hours of work in an eight-hour day. This one does the arithmetic while you are planning, not at 6pm.

The first version was a plain todo list, written in 2022 as a Redux Toolkit exercise early in my career. In 2026 I rebuilt it rather than deleting it, and then gave it a reason to exist: capacity planning and a natural-language parser. The git history shows all three stages, which is the point.

Live parse preview that names the day it resolved, the estimate it read,
and the text each came from, before anything is committed
